name: controlcenter
description: Control plane for a home LocalAI infrastructure: DGX Spark cluster + NAS model store, recipe-based serving, OpenAI-compatible gateway with per-client telemetry, and power management.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w agent && npm run build:agent && npm run build -w web
scripts.build:agent: esbuild agent/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=agent/dist/agent.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
